title: Petra and the Vector
author: Jonah Okafor
blurb: Ulyana Thackeray, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
